description: Mining: Quota Shift: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Three miners on the quota shift in {system}. {enemy} know the hold is filling. Keep them off.
Quota shift. Five minutes of digging and a lot of raiders. {client} pays on a full hold.
Guard the crew. Raiders will come in waves.
success: Quota met. {client} pays {captain} with a bonus.
Hold is full and the crew is whole.
Shift over. The ore is safe.
failure: The crew is cut down. {client} abandons the seam.
A miner is lost and the quota with it.
radio-crew: Crew is cutting. Stay with them.
Miners working. Keep clear of their cutters.
radio-pirates: Contact, far. They are heading for the miners.
radio-pirates2: Right side. They will go for the miners.
radio-pirates3: They are making one more try. Behind you.
